body.name: Balanced-Poisson unbiased polynomial lift
body.construction: Write the finite monomial representation as \(P_L(\theta)=\sum_{\alpha\in\mathcal A_{K,L}}c_\alpha\theta^\alpha\) and set \(U_{P_L}=\sum_{\alpha\in\mathcal A_{K,L}}c_\alpha\prod_{a=1}^K H_{\alpha_a}(N_{a0},N_{a1};\lambda)\). Compute \(H_0,\ldots,H_L\) for each arm by the finite convolution \([z^h](1+2z)^{N_{a1}}(1-2z)^{N_{a0}}=\sum_{r=0}^h\binom{N_{a1}}r\binom{N_{a0}}{h-r}2^r(-2)^{h-r}\). Given the coefficient table, dense exact evaluation uses at most \(C_0\{K L^2+L M_{K,L}\}\) arithmetic operations and \(C_0\{K L+M_{K,L}\}\) stored scalars for an absolute implementation constant \(C_0\).
